decisions.reason: After a short market presence and no later web evidence of scaling, this more specialized offshore option appears to have revealed limited standalone value relative to the resources needed to sustain it.

This service closely leverages the firm's existing global crewing and support infrastructure, so the cost of keeping the option open is low and it strengthens the integrated end-to-end offer for maritime clients.

The portal seems to have remained an early digital experiment without continued visible commitment, suggesting the uncertainty has largely resolved without enough customer pull to justify further standalone investment.

A mobile performance app requires ongoing software development and user adoption that are not central strengths in this service-heavy context, and its brief visibility indicates the option value was not realized.
